bends.note: B1: the 90 deg fold between the web and the side flange, on the outer skins. Changed from 3-4. The web's outer skin is split into patches 4 (L 0-221) and 5 (L 226-457) by a 5.7 mm gap in the scan data, not a kink. They are one plane: 0.12 deg apart, joint fit leaves 0.031 mm scatter, no step along the length. Listing both makes the line span the full fold of about 450 mm. Flange patch 3 runs the full length near the fold. Fallback if a two-patch side fails: the inner-skin pair [[2],[1]] (448.9 mm). Do not mix skins.
B2: the 90 deg fold between the web and the end tab, on the outer skins. Unchanged. The line is 33.1 mm and spans the whole flat web width, from the web's free edge to the start of the B1 bend.
